$note.base: Weapon, armour, focus and dual-wield tracks: XP for the first step and the base used for later increases.
$note.linear: Use base + skill level × base × scaler. Off: use base × exponential growth^skill level.
$note.multScaler: Linear XP increase per step as a multiple of the base. At base 100 and scaler 1.3: 100, 230, 360 XP.
$note.growth: Exponential growth per step, used only when the linear curve is off.
$note.roundTo: Those tracks: every step cost is rounded to a multiple of this.
$note.maxLevel: The highest level those tracks reach (SPEC §13.4o: 10, about 100,000 XP); XP past it stays banked.
$note.perHit: Skill XP for a hit or block a track's card lands on a live target.
$note.perWinEquipped: Skill XP each equipped track earns for a won fight.
$note.killMult: Multiplies that win award for the one track that landed the killing blow.
$note.impactPerXp: Impact a heavy-armoured wearer must absorb per point of armour skill XP. Medium armour earns half as fast; light earns none this way.
$note.evadeXp: Armour skill XP for evading a hit in light armour. Medium armour earns half.
$note.buildupPerXp: Arcane Exposure buildup a caster must deal per point of focus skill XP.

$note.xp.base: The class track: what its first level step costs.
$note.xp.linear: Use base + class skill level × base × scaler. Off: use exponential growth.
$note.xp.multScaler: Linear increase per class skill step as a multiple of the base. Default 1.3.
$note.xp.growth: Exponential class-step growth, used only when the linear curve is off.
$note.xp.roundTo: The class track: every step cost is rounded to a multiple of this.
$note.xp.maxLevel: The highest class level (SPEC §13.4o: 20, about 100,000 XP); XP past it stays banked.
$note.xp.perWin: Class XP for a won fight.
$note.xp.bossKill: Class XP for killing an act boss, on top of the win.
$note.xp.perQuest: Class XP for a completed quest.
$note.tierAt.{i}: The class level at which tier {ordinal} of the class tree opens.

$note.{rarity}: The skill-track level at which {rarity} cards start appearing in that track's drafts.

$note.draftSize: How many cards a skill draft lays out for you to take one of.
$note.draftsPerCombat: The most drafts one track may hand out at a single reward door. The rest queue for later doors.
$note.featEvery: Every this many levels of a skill with its own feats lets you take one.
$note.attributeEvery: Every this many levels of a skill with linked attributes lets you raise one of them by 1.
$note.flatEvery: Every this many levels of a weapon, focus or dual-wield skill adds 1 to the main number of every card of that skill.
$note.rankUpBonusScale: A rank-up also offers 2-3 bonus options rolled like a blacksmith upgrade (damage, Block, Poise, cost, a tag); this multiplies their amounts (2 = double, rounded, never past the upgrade guards). 1 = same as a blacksmith upgrade.
$note.rankMax: A card's highest rank. Each rank past 1 adds 1 to its main number; a skill draft offers ranks up to the skill's level.
$note.favoredXpMult: Multiplies skill XP in the weapon groups your class card leans toward.
